svg.title: Which managed service holds which Magento state
svg.desc: On the left, the Magento pods of the cluster pocketcoffee-prod: the web Deployment, the queue consumer Deployments, the cron Job and the install and migrate Jobs. Four managed services on the right hold the state that must not live on a pod. Amazon OpenSearch Service holds the search indexes of the catalog under the prefix pocketcoffee, written by the indexers and read by every storefront search; if the domain is lost, the catalogsearch_fulltext indexer rebuilds it from the database. The ElastiCache for Valkey replication group pocketcoffee-prod-cache holds the Magento cache entries and their tags with the eviction policy volatile-lru and no snapshots; it can be rebuilt. The replication group pocketcoffee-prod-session holds the PHP sessions of customers and administrators with the policy noeviction and a daily snapshot; losing it logs everybody out. Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ, the broker pocketcoffee-prod-mq, holds the messages of the asynchronous operations until a consumer processes them; lost messages are lost work. The full page cache is not in this picture because it is Varnish, and the database, the media and the secrets are on other pages.
svg.text: Four managed services keep the state that a Magento pod must not keep
EKS cluster pocketcoffee-prod
Deployment pocketcoffee-web
storefront and Admin requests,
2 or more pods, env.php from env
Consumer Deployments
queue:consumers:start, scaled
by KEDA on the queue length
CronJob pocketcoffee-cron
cron:run every minute, indexers
in Update by Schedule
Jobs install, migrate, reindex
setup:install, setup:upgrade (which
declares the RabbitMQ topology)
Nothing below is stored on a pod:
var/ is an emptyDir, generated/
and pub/static are in the image
Amazon OpenSearch Service domain pocketcoffee-prod (OpenSearch 3.5, VPC, port 443)
Search indexes of the catalog under the prefix pocketcoffee (one per store view)
Written by the indexers, read by every search and category page with layered navigation
If lost: indexer:reindex catalogsearch_fulltext rebuilds it from the database
ElastiCache for Valkey pocketcoffee-prod-cache (TLS, AUTH token)
Magento cache entries and their tag sets, database 0, policy volatile-lru, no snapshots
If lost: cache:flush semantics, the cache refills, slower for a while
ElastiCache for Valkey pocketcoffee-prod-session (TLS, AUTH token)
PHP sessions of customers and administrators, policy noeviction, daily snapshot
If lost: every customer and administrator is logged out, carts in progress are gone
Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ broker pocketcoffee-prod-mq (4.3, cluster, AMQP over TLS 5671)
Exchange magento and the queues of the asynchronous operations until a consumer takes them
Publishers are the web pods and the consumers; consumers are the worker Deployments
If lost: the queued messages are lost work (bulk actions, async orders), not just slowness
Not in this picture: Varnish (full page cache, memory only), the database, the media and the secrets, which have their own pages.
